resources.string: Sign in with the username and password a parent created for you on the family dashboard. Your family profile is assigned automatically. Your password is not saved on this device.
Tap Allow VPN connection. Android then asks whether Temperance may set up a VPN connection. Tap OK so your family\'s rules apply on this device.
Without the VPN, family rules cannot apply on this device. Tap Allow VPN connection to try again.
Parents: so the VPN can\'t be switched off, open the menu, choose Always-on VPN settings, and turn on Always-on VPN and Block connections without VPN.
Why do you need more time?
Parents can now ask for this device\'s location.
Is this your child\'s device, or are you a parent? A child\'s device installs the family VPN. A parent\'s phone opens the family dashboard from anywhere, with no VPN.
This is a child\'s device instead
On the family dashboard at home, open Settings → Parent devices and tap Pair a parent device. Then scan the code, or paste the link.
Temperance needs the camera to scan the code. You can paste the link instead.
Point the camera at the code on the dashboard
This phone will stop opening the family dashboard. To use it again, pair it from the dashboard at home.
